title: Finite affine scheme refinement of an algebraic-space fppf covering
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and work with algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\{q_i:Y_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ be a small jointly surjective family on field-valued point classes [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family], whose maps are flat and locally of finite presentation on etale scheme charts [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. For every affine $S$-scheme $T$ and morphism $t:T\to Y$, there exist a finite set $J$, a function $a:J\to I$, affine schemes $V_j$, morphisms $r_j:V_j\to Y_{a(j)}$, and scheme morphisms $p_j:V_j\to T$ such that $q_{a(j)}r_j=tp_j$, each $p_j$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, and $\bigcup_{j\in J}p_j(|V_j|)=|T|$. Moreover the scheme coproduct $T'=\coprod_{j\in J}V_j$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] is affine, and its induced map $p:T'\to T$ is flat, surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and locally of finite presentation. The singleton $\{p\}$ is an fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site] and an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. The case $T=\varnothing$ allows $J=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 0DFQ (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), proof: choose affine etale charts V_ij of V times_U U_i and a finite subfamily of their open images; finite coproduct refinement of the resulting standard covering.

proof.text: Put $Z_i=T\times_Y Y_i$. These are algebraic spaces by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], and their projections to $T$ form an fppf covering by clause (2) of [lem-sfb-space-fppf-covering-calculus]. Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas $e_i:W_i\to Z_i$ for each $i$, using [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Clause (1) of the covering calculus makes each singleton $\{e_i\}$ fppf, clause (3) makes $\{W_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ fppf, and clause (4) identifies this as a scheme fppf covering. All choices and families are in the fixed universes; no $Z_i$ or $W_i$ is assumed quasi-compact or separated.

source.place: Tag 0DFQ (lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf-fpqc), proof, choice of etale scheme charts of the pullbacks; Tag 03Y9 (lemma-fppf), parts (2),(3).

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-fppf-affine-refinement] to the scheme covering $\{W_i\to T\}$: $T$ is affine by hypothesis. Obtain a finite set $J$, labels $a:J\to I$, and affine opens $V_j\subseteq W_{a(j)}$ whose composites $p_j:V_j\to T$ are flat and locally of finite presentation and jointly surjective. Define $r_j$ as $V_j\to W_{a(j)}\to Z_{a(j)}\to Y_{a(j)}$. The fibre-product identity $Z_i=T\times_Y Y_i$ gives $q_{a(j)}r_j=tp_j$ after precomposition with $V_j\to Z_{a(j)}$. These are exactly the required labelled refinement and image-union equality.

source.place: Tag 0DFQ, proof, finite subfamily of affine chart images; topologies.tex Tag 021P (lemma-fppf-affine).

proof.text: Form $T'=\coprod_{j\in J}V_j$ and the induced $p:T'\to T$ using [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Write $V_j\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A_j$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-affine-coproduct-spectrum], $T'\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(\prod_j A_j)$, hence $T'$ is affine. The coprojections $\iota_j$ are open immersions covering $T'$ by the coproduct lemma, and are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale]. Apply the last family criterion of [lem-sfb-scheme-etale-source-target-properties] twice to this etale source cover, for flatness and local finite presentation: $p\iota_j=p_j$ has each property, so $p$ has each. For every $x\in|T|$, step 2 supplies $j$ and $v\in|V_j|$ with $p_j(v)=x$; then $p(\iota_j(v))=x$. Thus $p$ is surjective.

source.place: Tag 0DFQ, proof, finite affine refinement packaged by its coproduct; schemes.tex Tags 01JB/01JC, disjoint gluing; descent.tex Tags 04R1, 04R3, etale source locality.

proof.text: The properties of $p$ in step 3 say precisely that $\{p\}$ is an fppf covering by [def-pc-fppf-site]; [lem-trf-fppf-covering-is-fpqc] makes this same singleton an fpqc covering. If $T=\varnothing$, take $J=\varnothing$ from the outset. Its coproduct is the empty scheme, affine by the empty instance of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-affine-coproduct-spectrum], with empty product the zero ring. The unique map $p:\varnothing\to\varnothing$ is surjective; flatness and local finite presentation hold vacuously by [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. All factorization conditions are empty. The same singleton fppf and fpqc conclusions therefore apply.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finite_affine_fppf_refinement {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type w} (Y : AlgebraicSpace S) (Yᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpace S) (q : ∀ i : I, Yᵢ i ⟶ Y) (hflat : ∀ i : I, MapIsFlat (q i)) (hlfp : ∀ i : I, MapIsLocallyOfFinitePresentation (q i)) (hsurj : IsJointlySurjective (fun i : I ↦ (q i).hom.hom)) (T : Over S) [IsAffine T.left] (t : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Y.obj.obj) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → I) (V : Fin n → Over S) (p : ∀ j : Fin n, V j ⟶ T) (r : ∀ j : Fin n, yoneda.obj (V j) ⟶ (Yᵢ (a j)).obj.obj), (∀ j : Fin n, IsAffine (V j).left) ∧ (∀ j : Fin n, r j ≫ (q (a j)).hom.hom = yoneda.map (p j) ≫ t) ∧ (∀ j : Fin n, Flat (p j).left ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (p j).left) ∧ (∀ x : T.left, ∃ (j : Fin n) (v : (V j).left), (p j).left.base v = x) ∧ IsAffine (∐ fun j : Fin n ↦ (V j).left) ∧ Flat (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin n ↦ (p j).left)) ∧ Surjective (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin n ↦ (p j).left)) ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin n ↦ (p j).left)) ∧ Presieve.singleton (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin n ↦ (p j).left)) ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage T.left ∧ Presieve.singleton (Sigma.desc (fun j : Fin n ↦ (p j).left)) ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage T.left
lean.note: The scheme maps p_j are over S; r_j are Yoneda maps. Fin n allows the empty family. Sigma.desc fixes the induced coproduct map in every concluding property. Reuses the landed chartwise MapIsFlat and MapIsLocallyOfFinitePresentation predicates.
